title: Dashboard after install or upgrade
summary: After package installation, restart-running replaces an already running machine dashboard while retaining its environment, host, port and bookmark. It leaves a stopped dashboard stopped and opens no browser; the public installer invokes it. Help and the source daemon own ui_restart_failed and specific stop/start/identity recovery; rerun the installer after recovery.
verification: Source/help observation only; no dashboard was restarted, opened or tested live.
